reference: PORTER SUBDIVISION, LOTS 1 AND 2 — Plat Book PM 231, p. 50 (MSA_C2381_19050). Seat Pleasant (18th) Election District, Prince George's County, Maryland. Tax Map 73, Grid B3; 200 Map 202 SE 06. Zone R-55 at recording (RSF-65 under the 2022 rewrite). Scale 1" = 20', November 2007. M-NCPPC Record File 5-09121. Basis of bearings: Maryland State Plane Coordinate System (NAD 83). Lot 1 = 9,598 sq ft (0.2203 ac); Lot 2 = 8,008 sq ft (0.1838 ac); 4,219 sq ft (0.0969 ac) dedicated to public use.
notes: Development of this property shall be in accordance with the approved Stormwater Management Concept Plan 41230-2006-00, or any approved revisions thereafter.

Approval of this plat is based upon a reasonable expectation that public water and sewer service will be available when needed, and is conditioned on fulfilling all of the Washington Suburban Sanitary Commission authorization DA 4916 Z 08 commitments.

The applicant, his heirs, successors and or assignees shall utilize an abutting driveway design, constructed per DPW&T standards and requirements. Separate, standard residential driveway aprons shall be provided along Rollins Avenue, if deemed appropriate by DPW&T upon the issuance of street construction permits.
legend: For Public Water and Sewer Only
_omitted: Signature blocks, the owner/surveyor certifications and the preparing firm are transcribed nowhere. The notes and legend are the recorded conditions and they carry over; a signature and a preparer's name attest to who did the work, and reproducing them on a drawing this engine generated would assert an authorship and a certification that do not exist.
